title: LED Light Bar 20" + 4" Pods – Complete Offroad Kit
descriptionHtml:
A complete lighting package for rough terrain

Driving in the dark or off-road takes plenty of light all around the vehicle. Buying everything separately gets both expensive and complicated.

Light bar and pods in one kit

This kit contains a 20-inch light bar and two 4-inch pods with wiring and a switch. You get both main light and extra light in one package.

Features

  • 20-inch light bar and two 4-inch pods
  • Wiring and switch included
  • Strong, clear LED light
  • Built tough for off-road use
  • Great for off-road vehicles, UTVs, trucks and boats

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
